You'll be part of a team with 16-17 colleagues and 3 supervisors, where we mostly speak English.The hotel is at a walking distance from Schiphol Airport. This is a great chance to work in a friendly and supportive international team with colleagues from mostly Poland and Ukrania. 
What are you going to do: - You will clean and prepare hotel rooms according to the hotel's standards. 
The work is active and structured, and you will learn an efficient way of working together with your colleagues. - Most team members clean around 20 rooms per shift, depending on the type of room and the occupancy of the hotel. 
Don't worry! You will receive training, support from your supervisor, and work as part of a team to find your rhythm. 
Work Schedule: - 30-35 hours a week - 5 days a week, including at least 1 weekend day per week - From 8Am till 16PM - so have the rest of the day for yourself!
